title: I may continue to work on #myfirstcms http://myfirstcms.jgregorymcverry.com/public/index.php but now that summer is here I think I will give @grabaper
summary: I may continue to work on #myfirstcms http://myfirstcms.jgregorymcverry.com/public/index.php but now that summer is here I think I will give @grabaperch a try. Has so many native #IndieWeb building blocks and add-ons. Been fun rolling my site by hand but I want to fold in more
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: I may continue to work on #myfirstcms http://myfirstcms.jgregorymcverry.com/public/index.php but now that summer is here I think I will give @grabaperch a try. Has so many native #IndieWeb building blocks and add-ons. Been fun rolling my site by hand but I want to fold in more
